neighbours.label: a small amount or low value on a scale: as little as, less than, only N above sea level
fire: The village lies barely 150 feet above sea level on a flat stretch of the coast.
A signal needs as little as three seconds to travel between the two stations.
Families who make less than $30,000 a year can apply for the housing grant.
Our highest point stands only 90 meters above sea level near the northern border.
With a tailwind, the crossing can last as little as forty minutes in the summer.
Anyone who weighs less than 50 kilos should not donate blood at the clinic.
The membership fee comes to as little as $20 for students at the college.
Each sample contained less than one gram of salt after the second rinse.
quiet: The village lies nearly 9,000 feet up in the mountains on a broad rocky plateau.
A signal needs as much as three hours to travel between the two stations.
Families who make over $300,000 a year cannot apply for the housing grant.
Our highest point stands a full 4,000 meters tall near the northern border.
With a headwind, the crossing can last as much as nine hours in the summer.
Anyone who weighs more than 150 kilos should see a doctor at the clinic.
The membership fee comes to as much as $2,000 for firms at the college.
Each sample contained more than a hundred grams of salt after the second rinse.

notes: Top examples are scattered: small, low, less, little, and digits in low figures. Probes: sea level 0.43, as little as 0.24, less than 0.18, just $500 0.12, against more than 0.03-0.05. Bare 'low' read only 0.09, so the median may miss.
